verdicts.reason: A: reading order is broken — the attribution sits in the middle, detached from the quote, with the big logo wedged between the text and the product. The quote is squeezed into a narrow four-line column and the quote mark floats far above it, so the logo competes with the headline. B: keeps the original order of quote mark, quote, attribution, then product, with a sensible two-line quote and the same left-to-right flow. Flaws: the logo is tiny, clipped and has a cut-off 'E' in its wordmark. The quote mark is offset from the text edge, the left margins are inconsistent, the product circle crowds the right edge, and there is dead space below the attribution.
